card.name: hammerdb-drpc
card.role: the hub record that asks for the move

def.what: The hub control record for one protected application.
def.creator: The DR administrator enrolls the application.
def.reader: Ramen on the hub and the console.
def.analogy: A job ticket that records the requested move and how far it got.

card.name: hammerdb-drpc
card.role: coordinates every protected disk on one site

def.what: The per-cluster coordinator for a group of protected disks.
def.creator: Ramen delivers it from the hub.
def.analogy: A foreman who tracks every disk job on one site.

card.name: hammerdb-rhel9-rootdisk
card.role: one disk, one requested replication role

def.what: The per-disk request that names the role the disk should have.
def.creator: The VRG creates one for each protected PVC.
def.where: The workload namespace on the spoke.
def.analogy: A work order for one disk, not for the whole application.

card.name: csi-addons-controller-manager
card.role: turns a VolumeReplication into CSI driver calls

def.what: The controller that watches VolumeReplication objects and calls the CSI driver.
def.creator: It is installed as a bare Deployment in this lab.
def.reader: It reads VolumeReplication and its class.
def.analogy: A translator between the Kubernetes work order and the storage machine.

card.name: powerstore-controller
card.role: executes the CSI calls against the PowerStore array

def.what: Dell's CSI driver and its csi-addons sidecar.
def.creator: It is installed by the Dell Helm chart.
def.reader: It receives the csi-addons requests and calls the array.
def.analogy: The machine operator who presses the buttons on the array.

define.text: The array pair was split by an unplanned failover. The promoted side can serve I/O, but the two sides are not copying.
The PowerStore array action that reverses a failed-over pair so the new primary becomes the source and the old site receives again.
